name: drift-provenance-heldout-glm-to-qwen
label: PREREGISTERED on 2026-09-21 before the held-out passages were generated and before any output of this evaluation existed
background: D1 and D1b measured source confusion on GLM -> Qwen3.8-Flash: conjunction items reached 0.00 to 0.15 with translated memory and 0.25 to 0.45 with the reader's own cache. While preparing provenance training, the step-0 validation (no training yet) of scripts/live/studio_train_provenance.py reached conjunction 0.90 on template passages with a different link prompt and question wording that NAME the two sources ('your partner's document' / 'your own note'). That observation is exploratory and confounds prompt and passage type. This evaluation separates them on fresh GLM-written passages.

design.passages: scripts/live/gen_corpus.py --n 230 --seed 7311 --heldout-vocab --require code,person,weight,colour (GLM-written, generated AFTER this file is committed); items built by scripts/live/d1_items.py exactly as D1 (conj / sum / hop), 40 per type, INVALID below 30 per type

arms_on_the_same_items_and_memories.d1b_untrained: D1b's concise arm unchanged: D1 link prompt, D1 'shared memory' question wording, untrained v3 translator (stacked3 + fanout3, gain power 1.5)
arms_on_the_same_items_and_memories.protocol_untrained: source-naming link prompt and question wording (question_protocol), same untrained translator
arms_on_the_same_items_and_memories.protocol_trained: the same protocol with the provenance-trained correction (loudness gate + source tag). Checkpoint rule fixed here: run out/provenance_run1, the saved update (150 or 300) with the higher pooled validation exact match on local/local_pair/d1/val.json; ties go to the later update. Its SHA-256 is frozen in configs/frozen.provenance-heldout.json before any held-out output exists.

design.decoding: greedy, 96 new tokens, question suffix ' Answer in one short sentence, giving the value(s) directly.' in every arm
design.scoring: D1's rule: every 'must' value present and no 'must_not' value present

hypotheses.H1_protocol_fixes_conjunction: conj EM(protocol_untrained) - conj EM(d1b_untrained) >= 0.30 AND exact one-sided sign test on discordant conjunction items p < 0.05
hypotheses.H3_no_cost_elsewhere: for sum and for hop: EM(protocol_untrained) >= EM(d1b_untrained) - 0.10
hypotheses.H4_training_adds: pooled EM(protocol_trained) - pooled EM(protocol_untrained) >= 0.05 AND exact one-sided sign test on discordant items p < 0.05

outcome_labels: Protocol verdict: PASSED if H1, H2 and H3; PARTIAL if H1 and H3 only; FAILED otherwise. Training verdict, reported separately: ADDS if H4, otherwise NO MEASURED GAIN. NO MEASURED GAIN does not show that training cannot help; with a protocol already near the own-cache ceiling there may be no room to measure a gain at this sample size.
expectation_stated_in_advance: H4 is expected to fail if the protocol alone is near ceiling, as the step-0 validation suggests.
significance_note: Each item is its own passage pair, so items are independent; arm comparisons are paired by item. With 40 conjunction items a true rise from 0.15 to 0.60 gives the sign test power above 0.95; the 0.30 margin is set from D1b's baseline measured at 20 items per type.
limits: One model pair, one direction, synthetic split-knowledge tasks of three kinds. A pass shows that naming sources in the prompt keeps translated memory and own context apart on these tasks; it does not show provenance under adversarial or conflicting content, nor in the reverse direction.
amendments: 2026-09-21, before any held-out output existed (the 230 passages had been generated by GLM but not read, tapped or evaluated): the training script kept only its last checkpoint, so the update-150 weights (validation pooled 0.978) no longer exist. The trained arm is therefore the update-300 checkpoint (validation pooled 0.933, below the untrained 0.967: conjunction 1.00, hop 1.00, sum 0.80). The checkpoint rule in 'design' could not be followed; H4 is now expected to fail more clearly. scripts/live/studio_train_binding.py, derived later, keeps every checkpoint.
